description: Append a value to an array, optionally extracting items by path first and skipping duplicates.
label: Array Push

options.name: array
options.label: Array
options.info: The array to push the new value into.

options.name: path
options.label: Path
options.info: If the array contains objects, the dot-separated path to extract from each item before pushing.

options.name: data
options.label: Value
options.info: The value to push into the array.

options.name: filter
options.label: Filter existing values
options.info: If true, the value will only be pushed if it is not already in the array.

options.name: logging
options.label: Logging
options.info: Enable debug logging to the console.

options.name: schemaModel
options.label: Result Schema model
options.info: Schema model for the output array type.

options.name: resultSchema
options.label: Result as schema
options.info: The updated array, typed to the selected Schema Model.

options.name: resultModel
options.label: Result as model
options.info: The updated array, typed to the source array's model.

options.name: resultText
options.label: Result as text
options.info: The updated array serialized as text.
